note: Prices are CNY per million tokens at the PEAK rate; off-peak multiplies by offPeakDiscount. Peak is Beijing time, Monday-Friday excluding Chinese statutory holidays, 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 (minutes of the local day). Add statutory holidays to peak.holidays as YYYY-MM-DD; while a holiday is missing, its weekday is priced as peak.
